classification.A_READY: Official vector, accessible and with a sufficiently explicit reuse route for a dedicated audit.
classification.B_AVAILABLE_NEEDS_WORK: Official geographic data exist, but layer contents, download, schema or reuse conditions still need resolution.
classification.C_CARTOGRAPHY_ONLY: Official maps or documents were found, but no directly reusable vector perimeter dataset.
classification.D_NOT_FOUND: No official perimeter vector was found in the official catalogs checked during ES-1; this is not proof of non-existence.
